components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Single confident CTA — Fork on GitHub.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-primary, #2890f8); color: var(--color-on-primary, #0a1220); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover, #4aa0ff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #2890f8) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.625rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #2a3a55); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-bg-elevated, #1a2740); color: var(--color-text, #e8eef8); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary, #2890f8); color: var(--color-primary, #2890f8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #2890f8) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Email Input
components.description: Buttondown subscribe field on the home page.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text, #e8eef8); } .ds-input { padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #2a3a55); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-bg, #0a1220); color: var(--color-text, #e8eef8); font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #2890f8) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--color-primary, #2890f8); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.html: DocsAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; } .ds-nav-link { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-text-muted, #9aacc4); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-text, #e8eef8); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: var(--color-text, #e8eef8); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #2890f8) 55%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Brand Wordmark
components.css: .ds-brand { font-family: Outfit, "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand-core { color: var(--brand-navy, #e8eef8); } .ds-brand-ext { color: var(--brand-blue, #2890f8); } .ds-brand:hover .ds-brand-core { color: var(--brand-navy, #e8eef8); } .ds-brand:hover .ds-brand-ext { color: var(--color-primary-hover, #4aa0ff); }

components.name: Template Shot Tile
components.description: Template preview tile with soft media shadow.
components.css: .ds-shot { border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #2a3a55); background: linear-gradient(160deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #2890f8) 8%, var(--color-bg-elevated, #1a2740)), var(--color-bg-alt, #121c2e)); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text, #e8eef8) 8%, transparent); overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; } .ds-shot-empty { display: flex; height: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1.5rem; color: var(--color-text-muted, #9aacc4); font-size: 0.95rem; text-align: center; }

narrative.overview:
The marketing site sits in a deep navy-ink field. Surfaces step quietly lighter as they rise; a single electric blue — sampled from the LeFolio logo — is the signal for links, brand extension (.md), and the primary CTA. Typography is practical system UI for reading, with Outfit reserved for the brand wordmark and hero title so the product name feels intentional without turning the page into a display-font showcase.

Density is spacious: wide home measure, generous section gaps, hero as one composition (demo + brand + one CTA). Product truth leads — demo GIF, vault workflow, honest copy — not decorative chrome.

Confirmed rejections: purple-on-white / indigo SaaS gradients; warm cream + terracotta editorial cliché; broadsheet hairline / dense newspaper layouts.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ink canvas with tonal surface steps (not heavy card grids)
One accent blue used sparingly as signal
Outfit for brand; Segoe UI / system for prose and chrome
Soft elevation only on media and overlays
Quiet nav; one confident primary button

rules.name: The One Beacon Rule
rules.body: Obsidian Link Blue is for signal (link, CTA, brand .md, accented words) — not large fills or decorative gradients beyond the soft hero glow.

rules.name: The Ink Field Rule
rules.body: Prefer stepping --color-bg → --color-bg-alt → --color-bg-elevated over introducing new neutrals.

rules.name: The Brand Type Rule
rules.body: Outfit is for LeFolio naming and hero title only — not for long paragraphs.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Chrome and prose sit flat. Lift only when something is media or temporarily focused (lightbox).

dos: Do keep the first viewport to brand, one headline idea, short support, one CTA, and the demo.
Do use Obsidian Link Blue for links, .md, and the primary action only.
Do step surfaces with the ink token ladder before inventing new grays.
Do put product imagery (GIF, template shots) at full compositional weight.
donts: Don't introduce purple/indigo gradient AI product skins or cream+serif terracotta tropes.
Don't wrap the hero demo in cards, stickers, or floating meta chips.
Don't set long-form copy in Outfit.
Don't treat ink-light tokens as the marketing default while config is ink-dark.
